reason: 5.17.6 both running and completed. A decision that reported its outcome through POST /api/actions/:id/outcome kept lifecycle status='running' forever, so Decision Replay rendered RUNNING beside a Completed outcome badge on the same line. The two closure paths only reconciled one way: a terminal PATCH implicitly advances outcome_status, but the outcome POST wrote only the outcome_* columns. setActionOutcome now closes status and timestamp_end in the same UPDATE (completed to completed, partial/failed to failed, lost_confirmation to unknown) and only when the lifecycle is still open. Neither sweep UPDATE could reach an affected row (both gate on outcome_status), so the backfill was broadened from lost_confirmation-only to every terminal outcome and existing stuck rows self-heal on the next sweep. No migration. Platform only, no Node/Python SDK surface change.
